response.overview: To get an additional stateroom on Princess Cruises  + 1 -888-512-8367|(US*Canada), you book a separate cabin reservation and ask Princess Cruises or your travel advisor to link the bookings together. You cannot add a second physical cabin directly inside an existing online reservation or the mobile app  + 1 -888-512-8367|(US*Canada).  Key Rules & Booking Tips  • Link & Mark "No Upgrade": + 1 -888-512-8367|(US*Canada) Users on Cruise Critic agree that booking multiple or connecting cabins online isn't fully supported, and calling  + 1 -888-512-8367|(US*Canada) to link reservations and mark them as "no upgrade" helps keep rooms together. • Adult Requirement:+ 1 -888-512-8367|(US Every separate stateroom must have at least one adult booked on the reservation To add another room to a Princess cruise, you must book a new,+ 1 -888-512-8367|(US separate stateroom reservation—there is no button to add an extra cabin onto an existing booking online.
